description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of reference answers and test cases within a dataset. The chart contains three slices, representing “Null”, “Have reference answer”, and “Have test case”. The “Null” slice is colored light gray and represents approximately 8.9% of the total. The “Have reference answer” slice is colored light blue and occupies approximately 38.9% of the chart. The “Have test case” slice is light green and represents approximately 21.9% of the total. A legend is included, labeling each slice with its corresponding category and numerical value. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices appear to be ordered visually from largest to smallest, beginning with “Have reference answer” and proceeding clockwise.
